_comment: Verified corrections of identifiers that break the shape of their scheme (cinema_db/harness/build/id_rules.py). Applied by the layer builder only to the exact record that supplied the rejected value, and only if the replacement exists in the local IMDb archive with a compatible type and year.

evidence: nm1627110 is an IMDb NAME id: name.basics lists it as Ryan O'Kane (sound_department); it cannot identify a series.
Origin of the error: Wikidata item Q4000414 (Tumbling, 2010 Japanese series), property imdb_id = nm1627110, in the local snapshot pipelines/wikipedia_series/data/s2/wikidata_entities.jsonl.

The IMDb dataset (cinema_db/data/imdb_snapshot/2026-11-08) has tt1627110: tvSeries, startYear 2010, primaryTitle 'Tanburingu' (the romanisation of the original title the item records, タンブリング), 58 min, Comedy.
Same digits (1627110) with the prefix of a person id instead of a title id; the type and the year agree with the item (start 2010-04-17).
Checked 2026-11-09 offline against the local archives only; no external request.
